name: Nee-san no Kareshi ~Akogare no Nee-san ga Shin'yuu to Tsukiai Hajimemashita~
original_name: 姉さんのカレシ ～憧れの姉さんが親友と付き合い始めました～
source:
The season is early summer. The protagonist is living an ordinary but enjoyable school life with his proud older sister Himekawa Iori and his best friend since childhood Tagami Seiji. The protagonist is very conscious of his sister as the ideal version of the opposite sex, but at the same time, he almost gives up on the idea as she is unreachable. The older sister, Iori, has feelings for her younger brother, but is reluctant to reveal them outwardly because she fears for his future. His best friend, Seiji, who was born the only son of a wealthy family but grew up in a distorted family environment, is starved for affection and harbors illicit feelings for Iori. The three of them, each with their own mental distortions, are still on good terms on the surface and continue to have a good relationship. One day, however, as the summer holidays approach, their relationship changes.  When Iori visits the protagonist's room, she witnesses him masturbating to her. She wonders if there is anything she can do to make him give up his feelings for her.

After much struggle, the answer she comes up with is to talk to Seiji about it, who has a lot of experience with male-female relationships. Seiji, who has wanted to make Iori his own woman since childhood, pretends to be her advisor and tries to fulfil his own desires. After persuading Iori that it is for her brother's future, Seiji asks her to go out with him for a month. Thus, Iori and Seiji begin their relationship as lovers. As Iori's younger brother and Seiji's best friend, the protagonist tries to support their relationship, but... he spends his days in agony at the sight of his sister gradually being transformed to Seiji's liking. As if to spite the protagonist, Seiji's 'lover lessons' for Iori begin to escalate.

[Translated from [url=http://dl.getchu.com/i/item1004487]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
季节是初夏。主人公与引以为傲的姐姐姬川伊织、从小就最好的朋友田上征司一起过着平凡而愉快的学校生活。主角非常意识到他的妹妹是理想的异性版本，但同时，他几乎放弃了这个想法，因为她遥不可及。姐姐伊织对弟弟有感情，但不愿公开表达，因为她担心弟弟的未来。他最好的朋友诚司出生于富裕家庭，但在扭曲的家庭环境中长大，他渴望感情，并对伊织怀有不正当的感情。心理各有扭曲的三人，表面上依然关系很好，继续保持着良好的关系。然而有一天，随着暑假的临近，他们的关系发生了变化。当伊织参观主角的房间时，她目睹了他对她自慰。她想知道是否可以做些什么来让他放弃对她的感情。

经过一番挣扎，她得出的答案是与在男女关系方面拥有丰富经验的Seiji讨论这件事。从小就想让八织成为自己女人的精司假装是她的顾问，并试图实现自己的愿望。在说服伊织这是为了她哥哥的未来之后，诚司邀请她和他出去一个月。伊织和诚二就这样开始了恋人关系。作为Iori的弟弟和Seiji最好的朋友，主角试图维持他们的关系，但是……当他看到自己的妹妹逐渐变成Seiji喜欢的样子时，他每天都在痛苦中度过。仿佛是为了激怒主角，征司对伊织的“情人课”开始升级。
